notes: Offered only at UC Medical Center, 3188 Bellevue Ave. The page says joining depends on space and on who qualifies. Age and grade rules are not stated.
name: Career Journeys Program (UC Medical Center)
what_you_do: You learn what hospital jobs are like, both with patients and behind the scenes. You hear from staff, go on tours and join online sessions.
who_can_apply: Eligible local high school students. Space is limited. Exact age and grade rules are not stated on the page.
duration: September to March, twice a month, 6 to 8 p.m., in person
deadline_text: The page links an online application and gives no deadline.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application linked from the program page. Questions: UCH-HighSchools@UCHealth.com.
